headline: Brent Crude Volatile Amid Conflicting Reports on U.S.-Iran Peace Talks
summary: Brent crude plunged by more than $6 per barrel to $100.80 before recovering to around $103.46 following a succession of conflicting reports about U.S.-Iran peace negotiations and U.S. strikes.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity and energy input, with its price movements directly influencing inflation expectations, energy sector revenues, and macroeconomic conditions worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The input explicitly reports that Brent crude dropped by over $6 per barrel during the session.

why_moved: Traders reacted sharply to conflicting reports regarding U.S.-Iran peace negotiations and U.S. strikes, driving high volatility and a temporary flash crash in oil prices.
